links.outcome: Model performance with versus without drift-adaptive framework for hospital and ICU stay prediction
links.effect: Models incorporating a drift adaptive framework outperformed models without one; ensemble achieved minimum MAE of 10.684 (hospital stay) and 2.827 (ICU stay).
links.quote: Furthermore, the models that incorporate a drift adaptive framework exhibit superior performance compared to the models that do not include such a framework.

unlisted_practices: Drift detection techniques applied to survival outcome time series
Ensemble, incremental and adaptive learning as drift adaptation strategies
